prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE silly high-level proton magnetometer concept diagram, an intentionally terrible yet charming Microsoft Paint mouse doodle. White background, shaky black outlines, basic flat bucket-fill colors, uneven handwritten lowercase labels, sparse and extremely legible. Show a boat at water surface towing an underwater towfish on a cable. Sensor is INSIDE towfish. Proton wiggle is INSIDE the sensor (use a magnified bubble if needed), depicted as tiny wobbly spinning arrows/dots, not actual animals. The concept: briefly align protons, release, listen to their wiggle to measure magnetic field. Only conceptual doodles; NO circuits, schematics, electrical components, equations, technical details or photorealism. Required exact labels: "boat", "towfish", "sensor", "proton wiggle". Make their association unmistakable. Landscape image, generous white margins. Classic side-view ocean scene with lumpy boat at upper left, cable sloping to a goofy orange towfish underwater at right, sensor visible through simple cutaway and a large zoom bubble with tiny spinning proton doodles. Only the four required labels. The towfish looks vaguely like a potato with a tail fin.
